name: Feature documentation
about: Create or update a feature doc following the project structure
title: "docs: <Feature Name>"
labels: documentation

## Feature name

- File: FEATURES/<Feature-Name>.md
- Status: Planned / In Progress / Implemented

## Summary

One sentence describing the feature and purpose.

## Relevant paths

- List folders/files touched (e.g., Assets/..., Scripts/..., Scenes/...)

## Release notes

- Bulleted list of changes (plain-English summary)

## Developer notes

- TODOs found in code, refactor hints, risks

## Goals / Next steps

- [ ] Task 1
- [ ] Task 2

## Links

- PRs/issues/commits (optional)

## Checklist

- [ ] Created/updated `FEATURES/<Feature-Name>.md` using template
- [ ] Updated `FEATURES.md` (Todo link + Details section)
- [ ] Updated `README.md` Project Progress (if applicable)
- [ ] Cross-linked moved content from related feature docs (if applicable)
